entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... I see the Urban Commuter Helmet. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong color. The box is still unopened, so it's perfect. I just don't want it.
I see. So just a color preference. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, it looks like it was delivered to you 81 days ago.
One moment while I confirm our policy. ... Yes, our policy states that you have 90 days to return standard items. Since this helmet was delivered 81 days ago, you are still within that window.
Fine. So you'll take it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply print it, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially when it comes to safety equipment.
Whatever. How long until I get my money back?
Once our warehouse receives the item and confirms its condition, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
Right. Should've been a simpler process.
I apologize for any inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
